name: The Salty Dog
headline: Pet-friendly family home four miles from Navarre Beach
summary: A newer three-bedroom home created for families, groups, and four-legged guests, with a fenced backyard, beach gear, games, and room for up to ten.

reviews.note: A newly launched stay hosted by an experienced Airbnb Superhost.

testimonial.quote: The property was spacious, very clean, and so inviting. The beach items were a great addition and came in handy.
